uid.description: Stable case UID; migrated cases preserve their original assignment UID.
uid.title: Uid

subject_uid.description: Business Person UID whose evidence is assessed; never a staff identity.
subject_uid.title: Subject Uid

case_type_key.description: Explicit business process governing which Document Set versions may be selected.
case_type_key.title: Case Type Key

document_set_key.description: Foreign-key part identifying the pinned requirement policy.
document_set_key.title: Document Set Key

document_set_version.description: Foreign-key part identifying the exact published policy version.
document_set_version.title: Document Set Version

revision.description: Case evidence-membership revision used to reject stale writes.
revision.title: Revision

created_at.description: UTC instant when the case was created, retained during migration.
created_at.title: Created At

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest case evidence-membership change.
updated_at.title: Updated At

document_uids.description: Selected logical documents belonging to this subject; empty when a case is first opened.
document_uids.title: Document Uids
